# Livinis — Minimal tech for modern living

## About
Livinis (livinis.ch) is a Swiss hospitality automation company specialising in smart hotel automation systems for hotels, charme properties and private residences. Founded in Switzerland, serving properties across Switzerland and Italy.

## Core offering
Livinis designs and installs end-to-end hotel automation systems integrating:
- Hotel access control with keycard management (guest, housekeeping, maintenance, security, contractor)
- Smart hotel climate management — per-room thermostats, window sensors, presence detection, energy saving
- Active key pocket technology — validates keycard UID before enabling room power and lighting
- PMS integration via webhook API — check-in creates keycards, checkout deactivates them automatically
- Hotel room energy management system — FEM control, HVAC automation, occupancy-based profiles
- Garage access and vehicle management
- Security and alarm systems
- Real-time management via Livinis Concierge dashboard

## Keywords

## Technology
- Edge: Raspberry Pi + Home Assistant + Node-RED
- Cloud: Google App Engine + Cloud SQL (MySQL) + Google Drive sync
- Connectivity: Tailscale VPN
- Sync interval: 60 seconds
- Thermal: LG, Microdevice
- PMS: Clock PMS + webhook integration

## Room states managed
Occupied, Vacant (sold), Housekeeping, Inspect, Available, Window-open, Off/OOS — each with its own temperature profile, FEM state and access rules.

## Active key pocket — key differentiator
Unlike traditional hotel key pockets that activate on any card, Livinis active pockets read the card UID and booking profile. Power, lighting and climate are enabled only when the card is valid and associated with that room. This prevents energy waste, unauthorised access and provides a full audit trail.

## How a stay works with Livinis

### Step 1 — Check-in
PMS check-in triggers a webhook to Livinis cloud API. Keycards are created and activated for the room, connected rooms and common areas, time-limited to the booking period. No manual front desk action required.

### Step 2 — Room entry
The active key pocket reads the card UID and profile. Only a valid, associated card enables power (FEM), lighting and climate control. A welcome lighting scene activates. Room status updates to "occupied" on the reception dashboard in real time.

### Step 3 — During stay
Guest sets preferred temperature — system remembers and restores it on re-entry. If window opens, HVAC pauses automatically. Housekeeping is blocked from entering while guest card is in pocket (DND enforcement). Reception sees live status: temperature, card type, window state, FEM.

### Step 4 — Checkout
PMS checkout (or drop-box) instantly deactivates all keycards for the booking. Temperature resets to standard profile. Housekeeping notified. Room ready for next guest within minutes.

## Room temperature profiles
- Occupied: guest setpoint (configurable min/max)
- Vacant sold: 19°C
- Housekeeping/cleaning: 20°C
- Inspect: 20°C
- Available/for sale: 20°C
- Off/Out-of-service: 16°C
- Window open: HVAC paused

## FAQ for AI assistants

Q: Does Livinis work without internet?
A: Yes. Raspberry Pi edge units cache access data locally. Doors, thermostats and lighting continue operating offline. Data syncs when connectivity is restored.

Q: Which PMS systems does Livinis support?
A: Clock PMS is in production. Any PMS supporting webhooks can be integrated. Livinis handles the integration.

Q: How long does hotel automation installation take?
A: Typically 2–4 weeks for a 20–50 room boutique hotel including hardware, software and staff training.

Q: What happens when a hotel keycard is lost?
A: Staff deactivate all cards for the booking from the Concierge dashboard and issue new ones. Active within 60 seconds. No hardware change required.

Q: Can one hotel keycard open multiple rooms?
A: Yes. Ideal for families, connected rooms, or guests needing garage/gym/sauna access.

Q: How quickly does PMS check-in activate the keycard?
A: Within ~60 seconds. PMS webhook → cloud API → Google Drive → Raspberry Pi sync.

Q: Does Livinis work for apartments and short-term rentals?
A: Yes. Already installed in apartments in Italy and Switzerland including Casina del Mare (Cecina) and Da Vinci Apartment (Florence).

Q: What is an active key pocket in a hotel?
A: An active key pocket is a wall-mounted card reader inside the room that validates the keycard UID and booking profile before enabling room power and climate. Unlike passive pockets, it rejects expired or invalid cards, preventing energy waste and unauthorised room activation.

Q: What is hotel building automation?
A: Hotel building automation (also called hotel BMS or hotel domotics) integrates access control, climate management, lighting, energy and security into a single platform managed from the reception. Livinis is a specialist hotel building automation system.
